title: Benny Cancelled Japan Because the Yen 'Collapsed' (Big Mistake)
description: Benny cancelled his Japan trip because he heard the yen collapsed. Maya explains why a weak yen makes Japan cheaper for visitors, why the yen is near 160 to the dollar, and why Tokyo might step in.

lines.text: Benny just *cancelled* his trip to Japan, because he read that the yen collapsed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Which is honestly the *best thing* that's ever happened to his holiday.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Maya, it's at *one-sixty*. I read it. Well... I read the headline. And one comment. The comment was very upset.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: One-sixty *yen*, Benny. Per dollar. Put the suitcase down.

lines.speaker: benny

lines.text: Currencies trade in pairs. This week one US dollar bought almost *160 yen*, the most in more than two months, according to Reuters.

lines.text: So the yen got *weaker*...

lines.text: For you? Basically.
